outages.cause: Rolling blackouts after attacks on energy infrastructure
outages.affected: Ukrenergo said hourly rolling blackouts of 1.5 to 3 queues (about 12–16 hours a day in many regions) are scheduled for Friday, Nov 13.

outages.cause: Generation capacity deficit (multiple thermal units offline or in maintenance)
outages.affected: 1,890 MW forecast to be affected at peak (1,860 MW deficit). 1,395 MW already affected at 6:00 a.m. Cuba time.
outages.updated: Nov 12, 2026 (UNE morning report; no later official national part found)

outages.cause: National generation shortfall after the Tarbela fifth-extension incident reduced hydropower output
outages.affected: About 1,500 MW national shortfall (peak demand about 16,000 MW vs. about 14,500 MW available). LESCO/Lahore shortfall about 800 MW, with 3–4 hours of evening load-shedding.

outages.cause: Severe storms; more than 400 powerlines downed, concentrated in Logan
outages.affected: Energex said 90%+ of customers who lost power had been restored as of 8:30 a.m. Nov 13 AEST. Its homepage listed 50 unplanned outages at 9:45 a.m. Nov 13 AEST. Peak was more than 80,000 customers.
outages.updated: Nov 13, 2026, 9:45 a.m. AEST (5:45 PM CT Nov 12)

outages.place: Mayfair, Auckland Park, and nearby suburbs
outages.etr: Some customers as early as Sunday, Nov 15; last group by the following weekend (City Power estimates, subject to safety tests)
outages.updated: Nov 12, 2026, 7:49 p.m. SAST (11:49 a.m. CT); no later official update found

outages.place: Lagos, Abuja, Ogun, Kwara, and Oyo
outages.cause: Gas constraints, maintenance, and reduced hydropower output; not a national grid collapse
outages.affected: Outages were still being reported in parts of Lagos on Nov 12, despite a Nov 9 announcement that the repaired Benin–Egbin 330 kV line had lifted Lagos Complex supply above 1,000 MW. No official customer count found.
